thread:
maya: Quick sync — customer A wants the EU rollout to be opt-in and blocked from beta canary until we prove latency <120ms consistently. They also asked for a hard kill-switch and audit trail.

olivia: They reiterated compliance needs in the last call, yes. We promised an opt-in path + KMS logs.

evan: For the canary plan I suggest a 3-wave approach: 1) internal shadow (100% traffic shadowed), 2) 5% EU tenants + traffic mirroring, 3) 25% cohorts with telemetry gates.

nithin: Ops constraints: we need fallback routing to US if EU capacity / quantized models drop below SLO. That means routing policy + token accounting.

maya: Agree. Proposal: feature flag "eu_optin_canary_v2" with states: off / shadow / partial / full. Rollout rules: tag tenants, enforce KMS key presence for partial/full.

evan: Implementation note: flag should enable model variant selector + routing priority. Pseudocode: 
```
if flag == "partial": route_to_eu_if(health_ok && latency_median<120)
else if flag == "full": route_to_eu
else: route_default
```

olivia: Customer ops need a per-tenant opt-out endpoint + a one-click kill-switch in Console. Can we scope that for GA?

maya: For launch criteria let's require: 1) 3 consecutive days median latency <120ms, 2) error rate <0.5% for EU model pool, 3) audit events for every flag change.

nithin: SRE asks: add circuit-breaker: after 30s of degraded latency, start shedding EU traffic by 20% every minute until stable. Also surface token burn delta in console.

evan: We can add a gradual fallback script that reduces routing weights: 
```
weights = [100,80,60,40,20,0]
for w in weights:
  set_eu_weight(w)
  sleep(60)
```

maya: Scope negotiation: Customer asked for per-tenant SLA. That's heavy — propose to offer a "priority opt-in" where they pay reserved capacity or we commit to a dedicated slice.

olivia: They are open to paid reserved capacity. I'll get rough $ numbers but they want the ability to start/stop reserved slice quickly.

nithin: Operational checklist for the canary run: 
- preflight infra test (slot allocation)
- KMS integration smoke
- telemetry dashboard + alerting (latency, errors, token burn)
- rollback automation validated

maya: Who owns rollback automation? Eng + SRE pairing. Evan for implementation, Nithin for runbook + alerts.

evan: I'll own the flag toggle API + automated weight script. Can add a dry-run mode that logs actions to audit.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-weight-controller v1 -> staging (build 5789) :rocket:

olivia: Small ask: include an event in audit logs when we auto-fallback (not only manual toggles). Compliance needs that trail.

nithin: Will include event type `auto_fallback` with reason and metrics snapshot.

maya: Timeline: P0 - implement flags + weight controller (2w), P1 - console kill-switch + audit (1w), P2 - reserved-slice billing + SLA docs (3w).

evan: Risk: cold-start quantized models in EU may spike latency during first N requests. Recommend prefix caching warmers before switching traffic.

maya: Good call. Add warm-up step to rollout plan: warm each model shard with synthetic prefix during shadow phase.

olivia: I'll prepare customer comms template: opt-in instructions + risk note + expected billing.

maya: Action items: @evan implement flag + weight script; @nithin define runbook & alerts; @olivia customer comms + pricing; I'll draft launch criteria doc and share.

evan: Ack, will send a PR with the controller and `--dry-run` soon.

nithin: I'll prototype the circuit-breaker alert and post runbook link here when ready.

maya: Thanks all. We'll do a 15m sync tomorrow after the first dry-run.

deploy-bot: canary-weight-controller v1 deployed to staging successfully (5789) :white_check_mark:
